title: Fourfold nonvanishing by minimal metrics and moving jets
summary: We prove canonical nonvanishing for smooth connected projective complex fourfolds: if K X is pseudo-effective, then $`H^0(X,mK_X)\ne0`$ for some positive integer m .
family_title: Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity

review.reason: Proves canonical nonvanishing for smooth projective complex fourfolds with pseudo-effective canonical bundle.
